description: Create a neighborhood petition for traffic safety. The petition should address the city council about speeding cars on residential streets where children play. Include: (1) A bold, centered title 'PETITION FOR TRAFFIC SAFETY', (2) Addressee line 'To: [City] City Council', (3) Problem Statement describing the speeding issue, (4) Proposed Solution requesting a speed bump or stop sign, (5) Justification with 2-3 supporting reasons, (6) Signature section with at least 10 signature lines including fields for Name, Address, Date, and Signature. Save as 'traffic_safety_petition.docx' (Ctrl+S).
